decision.reasoning_trace: The customer was looking for a versatile, high-quality backpack for daily use. While the ZOMAKE (prod_backpacks_099) has excellent reviews, its packable nature suggests it may be too thin for heavy daily carry. Other options in the feed were either overly specialized for specific activities like fishing (prod_backpacks_082) or sports (prod_backpacks_197, prod_backpacks_070), or carried significant complaints about zipper durability and material quality (prod_backpacks_136, prod_backpacks_184). The internal frame hiking pack (prod_backpacks_137) was too large for general needs. Given the mix of accessories and specialized gear, the customer decided none of the options perfectly met their criteria for a standard, reliable backpack.
